title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14231 TX-150 in Coldspring, Texas, as the "E. Marie Youngblood Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14231 TX-150 in Coldspring, Texas, as the "E. Marie Youngblood Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a US Postal Service facility in Coldspring, Texas, after E. Marie Youngblood.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the Postal Service facility at 14231 TX-150 in Coldspring, Texas, as the "E. Marie Youngblood Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or its hours.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
